item.title: Canadian curler didn't eat for almost five days in preparation for the Olympics
item.description: Brad Jacobs is back representing Canada at the Olympics in curling, and he just revealed a unique way of preparing for it.

item.title: The best things we ate in and around Vancouver this month

item.title: Westbank's major downtown Vancouver office tower project at steam plant site pivots to hotel, residential, and data centre uses
